changelog:
BobLimt v1.0.12

- New Good 7500 macro (Keybinds - Frequently Used): one keybind runs the full load-manipulation + 7500 sequence natively, no AutoHotkey.
- New QuickSwap tab in Swaps: bind a hotkey to any of your 20 loadouts to instantly equip it (opens inventory, loadouts menu, clicks the loadout, closes). Includes a customizable inventory-open delay.
- Keybinds window is now scrollable.
- Inventory and open-loadouts keys are now a single global setting shared across all loadout features.
- No changes to gameplay logic, the clear tracker, or the update process.
